rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Threads provides MCP access to the official Meta Threads API following Meta's published documentation. Tools are organized across authentication, profile and discovery, publishing, reading and replies, insights and search, location services, and diagnostics. The server focuses exclusively on officially documented capabilities, excluding webhooks and undocumented endpoints. Setup requires Meta app configuration with appropriate review approvals and Node.js 20+.
